recognize_zh: 高度細胞性骨髓中三系造血完整、巨核細胞形態正常；視野中央一個脂肪空泡被一圈同心排列的類上皮組織球及嗜伊紅纖維帶包圍，形成「甜甜圈」狀的環狀肉芽腫（ring / fibrin-ring granuloma）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis
Megakaryocytes normal in number with normal lobated nuclei; no clustering or atypia
Central ring granuloma: clear lipid vacuole surrounded by a concentric rim of epithelioid histiocytes and eosinophilic fibrinoid material
Maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors fill the intertrabecular space
No caseous necrosis, sheets of atypical cells or fibrosis visible
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis, including maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and morphologically normal megakaryocytes. In the center of the field is a ring (doughnut) granuloma composed of a central clear lipid vacuole surrounded by a concentric rim of epithelioid histiocytes and eosinophilic fibrinoid material. No caseating necrosis, atypical lymphoid infiltrate, or fibrosis is seen. Findings are consistent with a fibrin-ring granuloma in an otherwise reactive marrow; although classically associated with Q fever, this pattern is also reported with EBV, CMV, other infections, drugs and Hodgkin lymphoma, and special stains and cultures are warranted.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are loose aggregates of foamy histiocytes and lymphocytes around fat droplets without the organized concentric fibrin ring.
Infectious epithelioid granulomas are solid, may show caseous necrosis and Langhans giant cells, and contain AFB- or GMS-positive organisms rather than a central fat vacuole with a fibrin ring.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed infiltrate, which is not present here.
An arteriole has a smooth muscle wall and endothelial-lined lumen containing red cells, whereas the ring granuloma contains a lipid vacuole surrounded by histiocytes and fibrin.
